name: SOF Token
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.97). Replaced keyword guess "oracle-manipulation".
rootCause: The SOF token on BNB Smart Chain was exploited for approximately $225K due to a business logic flaw in its custom _update() function. During sell operations, the contract incorrectly transferred tokens directly from the Uniswap V2-compatible (PancakeSwap) liquidity pair to a burn address and immediately called sync() to update pool reserves. This sequence artificially deflated the pool's token balance without a corresponding USDT reduction, inflating the apparent SOF price within the same transaction. An attacker crafted a swap transaction that triggered this erroneous sell-side burn logic, causing the pool to burn its own liquidity and update reserves in a way that allowed the attacker to extract the pool's USDT holdings at the manipulated price. This attack pattern — abusing fee-on-transfer or burn mechanics that directly manipulate AMM balances via sync() — was a recurring vulnerability among deflationary BEP-20 tokens on BSC during early 2026.
